title: l10n_th_pnd / WHT — Thai PND + Withholding Tax Deep

key_findings.pnd_module_absent: l10n_th_pnd module is absent from Community addons; no dedicated PND module exists
key_findings.wht_module_absent: l10n_th_withholding_tax module is absent from Community addons; no account.withholding.tax model
key_findings.wht_via_account_tax: WHT implemented as standard account.tax records (negative percent) for 1/2/3/5 percent across PND3 and PND53 income types — see addons/l10n_th/data/template/account.tax-th.csv lines 26-73
key_findings.pnd3_report_defined: PND3 statutory report defined as account.report with Total Income / Total Remittance / Surcharge / Total lines — see addons/l10n_th/data/account_tax_report_data.xml lines 291-353
key_findings.pnd53_report_defined: PND53 statutory report defined as account.report with matching structure — see addons/l10n_th/data/account_tax_report_data.xml lines 227-289
key_findings.wht_accounts_present: Five WHT liability accounts (PND1 213300, PND3 213301, PND53 213302, PND54 213303, WHT Payable 213500) and two WHT asset accounts (WHT Creditable 114300, WHT Receivable 114401) — see addons/l10n_th/data/template/account.account-th.csv
key_findings.certificate_absent: No WHT certificate PDF template in l10n_th views — vendor withholding certificate generation is absent from Community
key_findings.pnd54_report_absent: PND54 account exists (213303) but no PND54 report definition — overseas payment WHT reporting unsupported
key_findings.payment_automation_absent: No payment-level WHT deduction wizard or account.payment override — WHT must be applied manually on bills
